### 2026-10-20 – Took ages to find a arduino pro micro symbol for kicad. All I could find was eagle. Got there in the end though. I'm new to this stuff so it took ages to figure out roughly what to do without a proper

**5.5h**

Took ages to find a arduino pro micro symbol for kicad. All I could find was eagle. Got there in the end though. I'm new to this stuff so it took ages to figure out roughly what to do without a proper tutorial, since the one on the website for 'new' pcb builders is a jump too large from week 1. I will connect the pro micro to eight buttons to form my midi keyboard from C to G notes.

### 2026-10-21 – I worked on code today. I started with a typical template for a MIDI by 'Nerd Musician' on youtube, and customised for 8 buttons from C->C. I realsised this wouldnt work great because it was built for

**5h**

I worked on code today. I started with a typical template for a MIDI by 'Nerd Musician' on youtube, and customised for 8 buttons from C->C. I realsised this wouldnt work great because it was built for arduino nano, but also it included other features I didn't really understand, like potentionmenters which I'm not using. Then I searched for a new template and found LOOK MUM NO COMPUTER's design. I modified it significantly and made some of the improvements that he had added to a more recent template I didn't use, and then checked over  my work with Chat GPT. It pointed out that I had written MIDI.h when I needed MIDIUSB.h, and I got it to teach me how to convert it.

**4h**

I changed a little of the code to make sure the pins mached with the schematic. Then I designed the PCB in Kicad from my schematic, after a little faf trying to get a Pro Micro footprint to work.
